title: Terms of use
headline: Clear expectations before you begin.
description: Website information is general preparation guidance, not an official determination.

sections.title: Official requirements
sections.text: The competent institutions and receiving organisations decide eligibility and acceptable documents. Their current requirements take precedence over general website guidance.

sections.title: Private assistance
sections.text: An enquiry does not create a paid-service agreement. Confirm the exact scope, charges, payment and cancellation arrangements separately before paid work begins.

sections.title: No promised outcome
sections.text: We do not guarantee a verification, attestation, correction, appointment, recognition or visa result. No universal processing time or official fee is promised by the website.

sections.title: Account and document integrity
sections.text: Use accurate information. Do not alter official records or share credentials. Applicant-only, appearance and consent requirements must be followed through the correct official channels.
